MoS2_bilayer_3R.note: DFT ISIF=4 residual-strain correction (fixed-volume, shape+ion relax from the ISIF=2 CONTCAR); corrects large residual in-plane stress (-20.4 kB) at the monolayer-derived lattice constant, fixed the imaginary phonon dip (-0.32 THz, off-Gamma). Averaged in-plane 'a' over the last 50 of 400 ionic steps (plateaued, std<0.0004 A). Rerun ISIF=2 relaxation at this constant converged to -0.72 kB residual stress and a clean 5x5x1 phonon band.
